android._captureInput_comment: 2026-05-16: removed captureInput:true — was causing two IME bugs: (1) Gboard didn't get cursor-position events so spellcheck suggestions never appeared in submit form, (2) when user moved caret mid-word and typed a character, composition events were intercepted before reaching IME, so the char appended at end of input instead of inserting at caret. Default (false) restores standard WebView IME behavior.
